subject_session: sub-11265_ses-16030604 (example); all 118 sessions / 620 units for population

headline_stat.name: significant grid cells (p<0.05 vs circular-shift shuffle)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000582 (Sargolini MEC) is the canonical grid-cell dataset, in the correct species, region, and open-field foraging paradigm.
justification.handling: Real NWB files streamed via remfile, cm/meters label issue handled explicitly, speed filtering and >=200-spike inclusion applied and justified, spike-position interpolation correct.
justification.analysis: Standard Moser-lab occupancy-normalized rate maps, autocorrelogram gridness score via opexebo, and a proper circular time-shift shuffle null per candidate cell.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (616 valid, 189 significant, median gs 0.93/max 1.44, spacing 60 cm, layer fractions) reproduces exactly from the committed cached results and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Effect is clearly visible, autocorrelograms show textbook hexagonal symmetry, panels carry sample sizes and units, and the example session honestly displays non-grid cells alongside grid cells.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and fully supported with no misrepresentation, but the write-up states no specific limitations (single-session dependence, no multiple-comparison correction), so it sits at the clean-result-without-caveats level rather than 4.
